title: Canonical restriction equation for a single chart
statement: For schemes X,Y,Z,H,K, an open cover U of X, maps q:Y→X, p:Z→Y, t:Z→X with p≫q=t, chart modules N_d, a module M on Z and direct component isomorphisms e_d:u_d^*N_d≅f_d^*M, fix one chart d. Write W for the iterated cover and d_d:W_d→U^t_d for the canonical chart map. Let C_d:w_d^*v_d^*N_d≅d_d^*u_d^*N_d be the three canonical composition and congruence factors. Given ν:H→Z, hd:H→U^t_d, r:K→W_d, z:K→H and k:K→Z with hd≫f_d=ν, r≫W.f d=k, z≫hd=r≫d_d, z≫ν=k, take S on H and τ:S≅hd^*u_d^*N_d. Let ξ:z^*S≅r^*w_d^*v_d^*N_d be pullback of τ, composition along z and hd using the given equality, inverse composition along r and d_d, and pullback of C_d inverse. Then ξ.hom≫r^*(epsilon_d.hom)≫comp(r,W.f d,k).hom equals z^*((τ≪hd^*e_d≪comp(hd,f_d,ν)).hom)≫comp(z,ν,k).hom. All compositions are in Lean order. This is a single-chart identity with no pair transition or pair-square conclusion.

proof.text: Factor the six canonical isomorphisms using the proved private six_factor_hom identity. In restriction_with_comparison, expand the restriction comparison and cancel the pullback of C inverse against the pullback of C by functoriality and the inverse-hom identity.

The private compOfEq_assoc is the component of Mathlib Scheme.Modules.pseudofunctor_associativity, after substituting the named composite maps; compOfEq_naturality is naturality of pullbackComp. The private restriction_calc applies associativity along r, delta, f, moves e through the comparison by naturality, cancels the inverse comparison, moves e through the z, hd comparison by naturality, and applies associativity along z, hd, f. The equations hr, hz, hnu and hzk identify the composites with k. The proved restriction_six_factors combines this calculation with the six-factor decomposition. Instantiate it at the canonical chart maps and the three factors defining overlapCanonicalChartComparison; the chart structure equation is pullback.lift_fst. No intermediate theorem is left unproved.

lean.statement:
theorem overlap_single_chart_restriction {X Y Z H K : Scheme.{u}}
    (U : X.OpenCover.{u}) (q : Y ⟶ X) (p : Z ⟶ Y) (t : Z ⟶ X) (h : p ≫ q = t)
    (N : (d : U.I₀) → (U.X d).Modules) (M : Z.Modules)
    (e : ∀ d, (Scheme.Modules.pullback (U.pullbackHom t d)).obj (N d) ≅
      (Scheme.Modules.pullback ((U.pullback₁ t).f d)).obj M)
    (d : U.I₀) (ν : H ⟶ Z) (hd : H ⟶ (U.pullback₁ t).X d)
    (hν : hd ≫ (U.pullback₁ t).f d = ν)
    (r : K ⟶ ((U.pullback₁ q).pullback₁ p).X d) (z : K ⟶ H) (k : K ⟶ Z)
    (hr : r ≫ ((U.pullback₁ q).pullback₁ p).f d = k)
    (hz : z ≫ hd = r ≫ overlapIteratedChartHom U q p t h d)
    (hzk : z ≫ ν = k) (S : H.Modules)
    (τ : S ≅ (Scheme.Modules.pullback hd).obj
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (U.pullbackHom t d)).obj (N d))) :
    let ξ := overlapRestrictionIso (overlapIteratedChartHom U q p t h d) z hd r hz
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (U.pullbackHom t d)).obj (N d)) _ S
      (overlapCanonicalChartComparison U q p t h N d) τ
    ξ.hom ≫ (Scheme.Modules.pullback r).map
        (overlapIteratedComparison U q p t h N M e d).hom ≫
        (pullbackCompOfEq r (((U.pullback₁ q).pullback₁ p).f d) k hr M).hom =
      (Scheme.Modules.pullback z).map
        (τ ≪≫ (Scheme.Modules.pullback hd).mapIso (e d) ≪≫
          pullbackCompOfEq hd ((U.pullback₁ t).f d) ν hν M).hom ≫
        (pullbackCompOfEq z ν k hzk M).hom
